description.value:
Applied by the fourteenth Scarlet Needle.

This creature's Strikes lose all runes. The fundamental runes are taken here — potency and striking both drop to nothing — which is where a weapon's numbers actually live.

pf2e has no alteration that clears property runes in one move, only ones that remove a named rune, so a flaming or a ghost touch rune stays until the GM takes it off. An NPC's Strikes have no runes at all: their attack and damage are flat numbers, and nothing in the system can find a rune to strip.

rules.text: The needles have taken this creature's runes. Property runes must be removed by hand.
rules.title: Runes Severed
